unusable_reason: This was filmed from the side, so knee and hip alignment can't be judged; please re-record from the front, 2–3 m away, phone at hip height, with your whole body from head to feet in frame.
summary: Thanks for sending this. The squat was filmed from the side, which shows depth and trunk angle well but hides whether your right knee drifts inward, whether you shift your weight to one side, or whether your hips tilt. From the side, your squat looks smooth and controlled with good depth. To check the three things we're looking for, please film again facing the camera, phone at hip height about 2–3 m away, with your hips, knees and feet visible the whole time. These are observations to discuss with your physio, not a diagnosis.
